description: This file defines classes and functions involved in generating and building API extensions and modules for a platform. It includes classes such as PackageBuilder, ModuleBuilder, ImportDefinition, ClassDefinition, and MethodDefinition, which handle tasks like building code files, generating import statements, creating class and method definitions, and handling command signatures and docstrings. The code integrates with FastAPI, Pydantic, and other libraries, and appears to be part of a system for dynamically generating, validating, and documenting API endpoints and their associated code.

classes.description: Builds the extension package, handles building, cleaning, and managing modules and references.

classes.name: ModuleBuilder
classes.description: Constructs the code for individual modules.

classes.name: ImportDefinition
classes.description: Generates import statements required by the modules.

classes.name: ClassDefinition
classes.description: Creates class definitions for API routes and containers.

classes.name: MethodDefinition
classes.description: Creates method signatures, bodies, and related command methods for API endpoints.

classes.name: DocstringGenerator
classes.description: Generates detailed docstrings for models and command functions including types, examples, and descriptions.

classes.name: PathHandler
classes.description: Handles building route maps, path lists, modules, and classes based on URL paths and route definitions.

classes.name: ReferenceGenerator
classes.description: Generates detailed reference data and documentation snippets for API endpoints, including method parameters, return types, and examples.
